explanation: Intended as the He–Togbé–Ziegler theorem (no Diophantine quintuple of positive integers). However, IsDiophantineTuple does not exclude 0, even though its docstring says "each element is nonzero" and IsIntegralDiophantineTuple claims to be about positive integers. Since 0·x + 1 = 1 is a square, {0, 1, 3, 8, 120} is an IsIntegralDiophantineTuple of cardinality 5 (I verified all ten products numerically). So NoIntegralDiophantineFiveTuple is false as formalized, and this "research solved" theorem is unprovable. Fix: add x ≠ 0 (or 0 < x) to the definition.
